# Signed tables as of 2026-11-25

Copies of every signed table in KicadComponents on that date, with two boards
that use them: the netlist, trimmed to the parts with a table, and the one
symbol drawing the check needs (a dual FET's units). Only the signer's name is
replaced.

`test_signed_tables_stay_valid` checks that each board is still fully checked.
Never edit these files. When the format changes, keep these passing and add a
new dated folder next to them.
